questions.q: Which actor plays the villain Kaal in Krrish 3?
questions.why: Vivek Oberoi plays Kaal, a disabled scientist with telekinetic powers.

questions.q: What power does the disabled Kaal use against his enemies?
questions.why: Though he cannot walk, Kaal moves objects with his mind.

questions.q: In which year did Krrish 3 release, on the occasion of Diwali?
questions.why: Krrish 3 opened on 1 November 2013 and became the highest-grossing Indian superhero film.

questions.q: How does Kaal plan to profit from the deadly virus he spreads?
options: By selling it as a weapon
By holding a city to ransom
questions.why: Kaal releases the virus himself so he can sell the cure.

questions.q: Which actress plays Kaal's shapeshifting henchwoman Kaya?
questions.why: Kangana Ranaut plays Kaya, a mutant who can change her form.

questions.q: What name does the film give to Kaal's human-animal hybrid creations?
questions.why: The Maanvars include Striker the Frogman, Cheetah Woman, Ant Man, Scorpion Woman and Rhino Man.

questions.q: Which real Alpine site served as Kaal's lab on screen?
questions.why: Filming in the Alps used the Sphinx Observatory as Kaal's lab.

questions.q: Roughly how heavy was Kaal's costume, reportedly?
questions.why: The elaborate suit was said to weigh around 28 kilograms.

questions.q: What does Krrish use to kill Kaal at the end of Krrish 3?
questions.why: Krrish finishes Kaal with the solar pen, a device left over from his father Rohit's experiment.
Rakesh Roshan was writer, producer and director of this third Krrish film.
